text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During a dance lesson with Manhattan Cafe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shuffle… Shuffle…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has the general movements down, but they don't quite fit the music…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: My dancing is a little… off, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Do you think… I should dance more in time with the rhythm? Or should we change the song…
choice_data_list: Let's try switching to a ballad.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Okay… I'll give it a go. More energy…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Whoa there… What the heck are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, Shakur… Are you here to dance as well?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Who cares what I'm here for. We need to talk about that dance you just did.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You were stiff as a board and your face was twice as wooden. That's not you at all.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Let's think logically here. What do your fans want from you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I can tell you it's not some half-baked attempt to look all cutesy. Am I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …No, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I see what I have to do now… Thank you for the kind advice.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What?! I wasn't trying to be kind. That weird dance of yours was bothering me, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If nothing else, Air Shakur has at least given us some useful critique.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A ballad… That might just work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure why, but the longer I watch her dance, the heavier my eyelids feel…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Listening to the slow and winding melody… with its melancholy tone…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …This is nice, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe continues to dance for quite some time…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer… Hey, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hm? We're in the dance studio…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I snap to my senses, only to find myself back in the dance studio. It's strange, for a moment there I felt like I was in a whole other world…
